scope: Validator-only numerical erratum. The v239 formal candidate, rank, folds, tails, coordinate map, gates, controls, result arrays, and pending decision remain immutable and are not rerun.

known_at_freeze.failure_reason: The first validator required the independent einsum reduction to reproduce the formal sum reduction bit-for-bit and rejected a SHA mismatch.

immutable_formal.formal_directory_role: The sole completed v239 formal output. It must be read-only and byte-identical before and after erratum validation.

single_correction.formal_rebuild_rule: The formal build must continue to match all sealed v235 Jacobi hashes exactly.
single_correction.independent_rebuild_rule: The independent implementation must retain its distinct einsum reduction. Its bitwise hash is recorded diagnostically, while identity is adjudicated only by the already frozen formal-independent inverse relative tolerance of 1e-10 after all independent direct-SVD residuals have been computed.
forbidden_changes: rerunning or replacing the v239 formal output
changing symmetric Jacobi scaling or using the opposite scaling
changing rank 64, folds, tails, centering, normalization, or weights
changing p90, worst, or late-frame gates
changing sealed controls or decision order
reading formal residuals before independent direct-SVD residuals are complete
adding a candidate, predictor, learned model, GPU run, or resource claim

decision_boundary: A successful erratum validation may only validate the already sealed v239 pending decision. Any other mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE; it cannot be repaired by changing the scientific candidate or gates.
